title: Manila Water units deliver emergency aid to flood-hit towns in Pangasinan

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — In response to the widespread flooding that prompted the declaration of a state of calamity in Pangasinan, Manila Water Non-East Zone operating units Calasiao Water and North Luzon Water, in partnership with Manila Water Foundation (MWF), provided safe drinking water to evacuees in the municipalities of Calasiao, Malasiqui, and Sta. Barbara. Through Manila Water Foundation’s AGAPAY: WASH in Emergencies program, a total of 350 units of five-gallon drinking water containers were distributed to evacuation centers and affected residents, helping ensure access to clean and potable water for families displaced by the severe weather conditions and flooding.
